resources.string: Everything you type through the VeriType keyboard is logged on this device only. Newest entries first.
This permanently deletes every logged entry stored on this device. This cannot be undone.

To use VeriType:

1. Tap "Enable keyboard" (or open Settings → General management → Keyboard list and default on your Samsung phone).
2. Turn on VeriType. Android will show the standard warning it displays for every third-party keyboard.
3. Tap "Switch keyboard" and pick VeriType as the active input method.

Everything you type through VeriType is then logged locally on this device. Nothing is ever sent anywhere — the app has no internet permission.
